title: Cobblemon Nebula Server
body:
Welcome!
Cobblemon Nebula is a recently founded Cobblemon Server!
Our goal is to provide every player with Non-P2W entertainment whilst remaining very community-focussed.
Our Server has features like Quests, Kits, Cosmetic Tags, Community Weekends, Custom Regional Forms / Fakemon (Only on Lunar Realm!), TMs, Cosmetic Particle Effects, Breeding, Wondertrade, GTS, Every Gimmick, Player Gyms, Legendary Shrines and SO much more!
Join us on our adventure through space, Voyager!
